docs.title: Flashing Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before flashing any build, make sure the following requirements are met:

  • Platform Tools — Install the latest Android SDK Platform-Tools.
  • Unlocked Bootloader — Your device bootloader must be unlocked.
  • Official Firmware — Ensure you are on the latest official MIUI/HyperOS firmware for your device and region.
  • External Backup — Formatting data (Factory Reset > Format Data) is mandatory for clean installations.
  • Recovery — Use only the recommended recovery specified in your device's installation guide.

Custom Kernels Not Supported

Do not flash third-party custom kernels. Reports of issues encountered with custom kernels will be closed without investigation.

docs.title: Recommended Packages
docs.text:
Most of the Custom ROMs provided here either come with GApps pre-installed or require you to flash them separately.

If you are downloading a "Vanilla" build (without GApps), we highly recommend using official MindTheGapps (arm64).

docs.title: MindTheGapps
docs.text:
LineageOS Recommendation

MindTheGapps is the officially recommended GApps package for LineageOS.

Choose the package that exactly matches the Android version of the ROM you are installing:

  • Android 17: MindTheGapps 17.0.0-arm64 (Latest Release) (for LineageOS 24.0)
  • Android 15: MindTheGapps 15.0.0-arm64 (Latest Release) (for LineageOS 22.2)
  • Android 13: MindTheGapps 13.0.0-arm64 (Latest Release) (for LineageOS 20 on spes)

docs.title: Sideload Procedure
docs.text:
1. Sideload the ROM zip first: 
    adb sideload rom.zip
  2. Reboot back into Recovery: Advanced > Reboot to recovery
  3. Sideload the GApps package: 
    adb sideload MindTheGapps-*.zip
  4. Reboot system: Reboot system now

Do Not Flash on GApps-Included ROMs

Do not flash GApps if the ROM specifies it already includes them (such as YAAP or any build with pre-included GApps). Doing so will cause bootloops.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Common solutions and recovery procedures for issues encountered during installation or daily use.

docs.title: Bootloop After Flashing
docs.text:
This usually occurs if formatting data was skipped or an incompatible kernel or GApps package was flashed.

Procedure:

  1. Boot into Recovery (hold Volume Up + Power).
  2. Navigate to Factory Reset > Format data / factory reset and confirm.
  3. Select Reboot system now.

docs.title: Error 1 During Sideload
docs.text:
This indicates recovery failed to verify or execute the installation script within the zip file. This typically stems from an incompatible recovery build or a corrupted download.

Procedure:

  1. Verify that your recovery build matches the exact recovery recommended in your device guide.
  2. Re-download the ROM zip and verify its checksum.
  3. Ensure platform-tools is up to date (adb version).

docs.title: Support Resources
docs.text:
If the above steps do not resolve your issue, join our community on Telegram. When asking for assistance, always provide:

  • Device model and codename (stone / spes)
  • ROM name and version
  • Exact error output or a full logcat

docs.title: Before You Begin
docs.text:
Data Erasure

Backup all important data to an external source before proceeding. This process will completely erase your internal storage.

  • A clean flash is mandatory if you're switching from another ROM or stock MIUI/HyperOS.
  • You must be on the latest firmware available for your device and region. Flash it manually if needed before proceeding.
  • Recommended Recovery: Use AOSP recovery.

Recovery Navigation

Inside AOSP recovery, use the Volume Up/Down buttons to navigate through options and the Power Button to select/confirm.

docs.title: Clean Flash
docs.text:
1. Boot into Fastboot mode
  2. Power off your device and use the hardware button combo (Volume Down + Power) OR

  3. Run: 

    adb reboot bootloader

  4. Flash the boot image 

    fastboot flash boot boot.img

  5. Reboot into Recovery 

    fastboot reboot recovery

  6. Format data

  7. In recovery: Factory Reset > Format Data

  8. Connect the phone to your PC

  9. Sideload the ROM

  10. In recovery: Apply update > Apply from ADB

  11. On your PC, run: 

    adb sideload rom_file.zip

  12. Reboot

  13. After sideloading completes, go back to the main menu and select Reboot system now.
